features.title: Paint your walk — the world paints in as you explore, a sketchbook, hints, arrival cards, map + search, sound
features.user_visible_behavior: Unvisited places are a pencil sketch that blooms into watercolor as you arrive, and your painted map is the record of every walk. Photo mode becomes a sketchbook with gentle commissions from real places plus spotting logs (boat/car/plane types). Context hints ('E — drive this car'), arrival cards when you enter a new town, an M map screen with address/place search + teleport, and a richer synthesized soundscape (halyards, lapping water, wind in trees, crickets, birdsong, engines, brush strokes).
verification: npm run typecheck && npm test
Montage: sketch→paint transition (unexplored vs explored), photo mode frame, sketchbook page, map screen with search results, arrival card, hint pill
node tools/soak.mjs --region=shore --seconds=90 — no new frame errors
Explored state + sketchbook persist across reload (IndexedDB)
evidence: tsc --noEmit clean; 99/99 tests incl. tests/explore.test.ts (vitest-compatible runner in the Linux shell)
Live montages: sketch vs painted at street level, golden hour, night and from the air (shots/sketch-a.jpg, sketch-b.jpg)
Photo mode: page saved to IndexedDB and completed commission 'Paint Gracie and the Dudes Homemade Ice Cream'; sketchbook grid + commissions/spotting page rendered
Atlas map with painted downtown; search 'asbury park convention hall' → walk here → arrival card 'Asbury Park · Monmouth County, New Jersey · first visit'
Hint pill 'E drive this jeep' next to a driveway jeep; flight hint while flying
features.notes: From the 2026-09-27 gameplay brainstorm (ideas 1+2 plus the agreed UX list and ideas 5). Everything region-agnostic: explored store is a sparse world-cell bitmap (not the slice), commissions come from real POIs/landmarks/kit types near the walker, geocoding degrades to local street/POI search when offline. Remaining before 'passing': npm run build + node tools/soak.mjs --region=shore --seconds=90 on the Windows toolchain.

Every model of one type is identical: each type has a single canonical model, so every SUV on the street is the same SUV. Extend the same recipe pattern to mailboxes, lifeguard stands, beach umbrellas, docks and playgrounds.

regions.note: The lower-48 factory. Each region advances planned → fetched → baked → verified → live. Gate: npm run verify:region -- --region=<id>. A region is 'live' only when verify-region exits 0 and evidence is recorded.
